# fptcloud_hpc_subnet (Data Source)

List the HPC (bare metal GPU) subnet catalog for a VPC on OSP, optionally
narrowed by filter. Each entry's `subnet_cidr` and `osp_network_id` are what
`fptcloud_managed_gpu_cluster` needs to create a bare-metal cluster on that
subnet — this is a **different catalog** from `fptcloud_subnet`; the two do
not share ids or names.

## Example Usage

### List every HPC subnet in a VPC

```hcl
data "fptcloud_vpc" "vpc" {
  name = "your-vpc-name"
}

data "fptcloud_hpc_subnet" "all" {
  vpc_id = data.fptcloud_vpc.vpc.id
}

output "hpc_subnets" {
  value = data.fptcloud_hpc_subnet.all.subnets
}
```

### Filter by name

```hcl
data "fptcloud_hpc_subnet" "hpc_subnet" {
  vpc_id = data.fptcloud_vpc.vpc.id
  filter {
    key    = "name"
    values = ["check-k8s"]
  }
}

resource "fptcloud_managed_gpu_cluster" "example" {
  vpc_id     = data.fptcloud_vpc.vpc.id
  network_id = data.fptcloud_hpc_subnet.hpc_subnet.subnets[0].id
  # ...
}
```

### Filter by id

```hcl
data "fptcloud_hpc_subnet" "hpc_subnet" {
  vpc_id = data.fptcloud_vpc.vpc.id
  filter {
    key    = "id"
    values = ["c009571e-72c2-4eb2-8dc1-c125d1e76901"]
  }
}
```

Filtering never collapses the result to a single object — `subnets` is always
a list, even when the filter matches exactly one entry. Index into it
(`subnets[0]`) to use a single match.

## Schema

### Required

* `vpc_id` - (Required) VPC ID

### Optional

* `filter` - (Optional) One or more filter blocks, combined with AND semantics across blocks and OR semantics within a block's `values`. Omit entirely to list every HPC subnet in the VPC.
  * `key` - (Required) Field to filter on: `id` or `name`
  * `values` - (Required) Values to match — a subnet matches if its field equals any of these

### Read-Only

* `subnets` - List of HPC subnets matching the filter (every subnet in the VPC when no filter is set). Each entry:
  * `id` (String) - Subnet id. This is the value to pass as `network_id` (and, on the same catalog, `internal_subnet_lb` is **not** taken from here — see the note below)
  * `name` (String) - Subnet name
  * `subnet_cidr` (String) - The subnet's CIDR — sent as `vm_subnet` by `fptcloud_managed_gpu_cluster`
  * `description` (String)
  * `gateway` (String)
  * `status` (String)
  * `osp_network_id` (String) - Sent as `osp_network_id` by `fptcloud_managed_gpu_cluster`
  * `network_acl_id` (String)

## Notes

* `fptcloud_managed_gpu_cluster.network_id` takes a value from this data source's `subnets[].id`.
* `fptcloud_managed_gpu_cluster.internal_subnet_lb` takes a subnet id from the regular `fptcloud_subnet` data source instead — the two subnet catalogs are unrelated (different ids), so do not mix them up.
